title: UI/UX Designer and Gameplay Scripter
points: Joined CoreStudio's Roblox team to design the game's UI/UX and write gameplay scripts in Luau.
Built a modular, server-authoritative anti-exploit system that catches speed hacks, teleporting, flying, jump cheats, humanoid tampering and remote spam.
Added an in-game admin dashboard, saved bans, optional Discord webhook alerts, and a configurable strike system that kicks and then bans repeat offenders.

title: Server Admin and Plugin Developer
points: Helped run BattleAsya as an admin and developer. The server had about 14,000 players, with up to 5,000 online at once, and kept that player base for several years.
Built custom Java plugins with the Spigot API, so they ran on Spigot, Paper and Bukkit servers.
Built a report and ticket system: when a player reports a cheater in-game, a Discord bot I made with JDA and DiscordSRV opens a ticket channel on the server's Discord, so staff can review it.
Wrote plugins that fixed bugs and blocked exploits, keeping the server stable for a large live player base.
The server still runs my ticket and report plugin today, years after I built it.
